requirement: Transfer editable HWPX curves between HWPX documents while preserving segment types, coordinates, control-point representation, ownership, resources, and durable serialization.

implementation.scope: Compile-verified endpoint-only HWPX curve package export/import. This is partial work and does not satisfy the editable Bezier control-point requirement.
implementation.behavior: The proposed RHWP API packages one standard curve and only its referenced embedded resources. It validates the supported root and segment envelope, rejects unknown or duplicate attributes, segment children, captions, textboxes, external or ambiguous resources, and remaps embedded resource references on paste. Destination mutation is snapshot-backed and restores the document on paste failure.

formatContractEvidence.officialSchema: KS X 6101:2024 revision 03, Annex E CurveType
formatContractEvidence.finding: The active CurveType contract allows each segment type and x1/y1/x2/y2 integer endpoints. It does not define separate Bezier control-point coordinates. RHWP's HWPX model likewise retains endpoint segment records and does not recover HWP5 cubic control points.
formatContractEvidence.decision: Do not invent control-point fields or translate endpoint-only HWPX segments into a different Bezier command model. P6-HX-CURVE remains partial until an authentic supported representation and sample establish the required editable curve contract.
